Exam: Paraspinal tenderness C4-C6 bilaterally. Spurling test negative. Strength 5/5 upper extremities.
Medications: ibuprofen 600 mg as needed, cyclobenzaprine 5 mg at night.

Plan: Start physical therapy 2x/week. Return in 4 weeks.
